title: What is actuarial science?
text: Actuarial science applies mathematical and statistical methods to assess risk in insurance, finance and other industries. Actuaries are risk architects who use data to predict the likelihood of future events and design ways to reduce their financial impact. Insurance is the most common application, with pathways in life and health, property and casualty, pensions and benefits, and enterprise risk. To explore further, talk to your professors, meet our execs at office hours, network at our company events, or try an actuarial co-op.
